title: The Lord's Love for Israel / Priests' Polluted Offerings

questions.question: The oracle of the word of the Lord to Israel by...
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:1 (ESV): "The oracle of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi."

questions.question: "I have loved you," says the Lord. But you say, "How have you loved us?" "Is not... Jacob's brother?" declares the Lord. "Yet I have loved Jacob"
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:2 (ESV): "'Is not Esau Jacob's brother?' declares the Lord. 'Yet I have loved Jacob'"

questions.question: "...but... I have hated. I have laid waste his hill country and left his heritage to jackals of the desert."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:3 (ESV): "but Esau I have hated. I have laid waste his hill country and left his heritage to jackals of the desert."

questions.question: If Edom says, "We are shattered but we will rebuild the ruins," the Lord of hosts says, "They may build, but I will..."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:4 (ESV): "the Lord of hosts says, 'They may build, but I will tear down,'"

questions.question: "A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If then I am a father, where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is my fear? says the Lord of hosts to you, O priests, who..."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:6 (ESV): "says the Lord of hosts to you, O priests, who despise my name."

questions.question: But you say, "How have we despised your name?" By offering... food upon my altar.
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:7 (ESV): "By offering polluted food upon my altar."

questions.question: When you offer blind animals in sacrifice, is that not evil? And when you offer those that are..., is that not evil?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:8 (ESV): "And when you offer those that are lame or sick, is that not evil?"

questions.question: To whom did the Lord say they should try presenting their defective offerings to see if he would accept them?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:8 (ESV): "Present that to your governor; will he accept you or show you favor? says the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: "Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in..."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:10 (ESV): "Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain!"

questions.question: "For from the rising of the sun to its setting my name will be great among the nations, and in every place... will be offered to my name, and a pure offering."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:11 (ESV): "and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering."

questions.question: "But you profane it when you say that the Lord's table is polluted, and its fruit, that is, its food may be..."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:12 (ESV): "But you profane it when you say that the Lord's table is polluted, and its fruit, that is, its food may be despised."

questions.question: But you say, "What a... this is," and you snort at it, says the Lord of hosts.
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:13 (ESV): "But you say, 'What a weariness this is,' and you snort at it, says the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: You bring what has been taken by violence or is lame or sick, and this you bring as your offering! Shall I... that from your hand? says the Lord.
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:13 (ESV): "Shall I accept that from your hand? says the Lord."

questions.question: "Cursed be the cheat who has a male in his flock, and vows it, and yet sacrifices to the Lord what is..."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:14 (ESV): "Cursed be the cheat who has a male in his flock, and vows it, and yet sacrifices to the Lord what is blemished."

questions.question: "For I am a great..., says the Lord of hosts, and my name will be feared among the nations."
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:14 (ESV): "For I am a great King, says the Lord of hosts, and my name will be feared among the nations."

key_verse_text: For from the rising of the sun to its setting my name will be great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering. For my name will be great among the nations, says the Lord of hosts.
